title: UI Focus Issue: Creating new animation in AnimatedSprite2D fails to focus on name field and deselects SpriteFrames editor
body:
### Tested versions

v4.6.1.stable.official [14d19694e]



### System information

Windows 11 Godot_v4.6.1-stable_win64.exe NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU

### Issue description

Bug description
When creating a new animation in the SpriteFrames Editor, the editor fails to grant immediate focus to the new animation's name field. Furthermore, pressing F2 to rename the animation incorrectly shifts the focus back to the AnimatedSprite2D node in the Scene Tree instead of the selected animation.

In some cases, the animation appears in the Inspector (right panel) but the SpriteFrames Editor (bottom panel) fails to display or update the content of the newly created animation.


Expected behavior
Clicking "Add Animation" should immediately allow the user to type the name.

F2 should be context-aware and prioritize renaming the selected animation within the SpriteFrames editor if that panel is active.

The Bottom Panel and Inspector should always stay synchronized.

### Steps to reproduce

Steps to reproduce
Create an AnimatedSprite2D node.

Create a new SpriteFrames resource in the Inspector.

Open the SpriteFrames bottom panel.

Click the "Add Animation" button (the paper icon).

Observed Behavior A: The cursor does not automatically jump to the name field for immediate renaming.

Observed Behavior B: Pressing F2 immediately after clicking "Add" selects the node in the Scene Tree instead of the animation entry.

Observed Behavior C: Occasionally, the bottom panel goes blank or desynchronizes from the Inspector's data.
